meta.title: ERTS: brand for renewable energy | Renee
meta.description: Brand mark combining wind turbine and leaf, pictogram system and campaign for energy producer ERTS, rolled out across outdoor, social and print.

name: ERTS
summary: A brand mark that combines wind turbine and leaf, plus a pictogram system for all communication.
challenge: The clean energy producer needed a clear brand and a language that holds across all channels.
solution: The mark unites rotor blade and leaf in a single form. A pictogram system carries the communication.
result: The line “Empowering Green Future” was rolled out across outdoor advertising, social media and print.
